item.name: Termux runtime doctor check
item.contract: `gormes doctor --offline --json` detects Termux via TERMUX_VERSION or standard com.termux PREFIX/HOME paths and emits a Termux runtime check only in that environment. The check proves desktop-like command-path readiness through $PREFIX/bin on PATH, reports optional termux-api wake-lock/notification command availability, and warns about Android lifecycle constraints with tmux/termux-wake-lock/battery-optimization guidance. It must not require live Android APIs, network access, root, or a real Termux device in unit tests.
item.degraded_mode: Non-Termux hosts omit the check from command output. Termux hosts missing $PREFIX/bin on PATH or optional termux-api commands receive WARN evidence, not failure. Android lifecycle caveats always remain WARN because background survival is best effort.
ready_when: Doctor already has structured JSON output and a CheckResult rendering contract.
Installer Termux detection already exists through TERMUX_VERSION and $PREFIX containing com.termux/files/usr.
Tests can inject env maps and fake PATH command probes; no live Android APIs are required.
not_ready_when: The check shells out to live termux-api commands during tests.
Desktop Linux/macOS/Windows doctor output gains noisy Termux rows.
The check treats missing termux-api commands as a hard failure.
The check implies local Docker, heavy browser automation, GPU/local LLM, or guaranteed background daemon parity.
acceptance: CheckTermuxRuntime returns SKIP with no items on non-Termux env.
CheckTermuxRuntime returns WARN on Termux env, with PASS command_path evidence when $PREFIX/bin is on PATH.
CheckTermuxRuntime reports PASS termux_api evidence when termux-wake-lock and termux-notification are discoverable.
Doctor JSON includes a Termux runtime check only when Termux is detected and includes command-path, termux-api, and tmux/wake-lock lifecycle guidance.
Doctor output does not require root, network, live Android APIs, or real Termux.
done_signal: Focused doctor fixtures prove Termux detection, desktop-like $PREFIX/bin path readiness, optional termux-api evidence, Android lifecycle warnings, and command-level JSON inclusion only under Termux.

provenance.note: Gormes-owned Termux runtime support; no upstream Hermes runtime dependency.
